name: Boku wa Kimi o Hanasanai ~Gomennasai, Boku, Kare ga Suki~
original_name: ボクはキミを離さない ～ゴメンナサイ、ボク、彼が好き～
source:
I , Kinoyama Ren, since I was a child, I've admired my chilhood friend and neighbour Tazawa Haruki-kun. He is my first love and I still love him. But there's no way I can say that.

He likes a girl.
His love interest is a girl.
But I am a man...

So I keep those secret feelings inside my heart.
I though I wouldn't say them in my life.
Haruki started dating my older sister and they become a couple.

One night, my feelings were exposed and were discovered by him.
But Haruki-kun also loved me...
translation:
我木山莲，从小就很崇拜儿时的朋友兼邻居田泽春树君。他是我的初恋，我仍然爱他。但我没办法这么说。

他喜欢一个女孩。
他的恋爱对象是一个女孩。
但我是一个男人…

所以我把那些秘密的感觉藏在心里。
我想我这辈子都不会说这些话。
春树开始和我姐姐约会，他们成了情侣。

一天晚上，我的感情暴露了，被他发现了。
不过春树君也很爱我……
